turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. I have until 4:40, Hale. Who decided, and when?
The checker said 94 percent. That's the end of it.

"That's the end of it." Your own procedure, 4.3, says software doesn't establish anything by itself, and I have the vendor's guide in my bag saying the same thing. So was Owen heard before you entered the zero, yes or no?
I don't need more proof than that.
"I don't need more proof than that." I'm writing that down, word for word, and the principal will read it before I leave this building. Is there anything on Owen's record right now?
The software doesn't lie, unlike some people.
My child never lies. Are you calling me a liar too, Hale? Withdraw the zero, or I'm going upstairs.

Then I'm in the principal's office at 4:40 instead of on my call, and if it stands there, it goes to the board under section 42. I'll want your reasons in an email tonight, Hale. Everything you just said is on this pad.
